What is MLAG and How to Configure MLAG on PicOS® Switches

In modern enterprise and data center networks, the demand for higher reliability, better bandwidth utilization, and non-stop service has driven the need for technologies that go beyond traditional link aggregation. One of these technologies is Multi-Chassis Link Aggregation Group (MLAG).

PicOS® 4.5.0M Released: Enhanced Features to Improve Network Stability and Efficiency

New Castle, Delaware - April 24th, 2025 - FS, a trusted provider of ICT products and solutions, has officially launched PICOS 4.5.0M, the latest advanced version of FS PicOS® switch operating system, offering resilient and efficient network operations for campus and data center networks. This update comes with enhanced features that boost network reliability, security, and scalability, such as DHCP ZTP, ECN, PFC, DLB, etc. The PICOS 4.5.0M version has been extensively tested, addressing several bugs and improving stability to assist customers in managing complex network environments.
